# Mishti Saxena

> Mishti Saxena is an urban designer in Sydney, NSW. She helps landowners understand what their land can really become — what the zoning allows, what could hold the site back, and what to do next — before they spend on designers, consultants or a DA.

## Free offers

- Free 20–30 minute chat: an honest first take on your land and your idea.
- Free Quick Zoning Check: zoning, key LEP controls (height, FSR, minimum lot size) and obvious constraints (flooding, bushfire, heritage) for your property.
- Free guide: "7 Costly Mistakes Landowners Make" (PDF) — the seven mistakes NSW landowners most often make before subdividing or applying for a DA, and what to do instead.

## About

- Urban Designer at Land Specialists Pty Ltd, Sydney.
- Master of Urbanism (Urban Design), University of Sydney.
- Bachelor of Architecture, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, Delhi.
- Works with the NSW planning system every day: LEPs, DCPs, SEPPs, planning proposals, subdivision, concept design and massing, DA support.
- Service area: Greater Sydney, the Central Coast and the Hunter, NSW.

## Notes

- The first chat and the zoning check are free. Paid work (feasibility and yield studies, planning research, subdivision and lot layout, concept design and massing, 3D renders, DA support, urban design reports) is scoped with a written scope and a fixed fee in advance.
- The information on this site is general information only, not legal or planning advice. Planning controls change over time.
